info.title: Bizz Mgmt
info.description: Salon Operations and Accountability Platform API. Money is always integer kobo.

get.summary: The person's own recorded work, newest first (UI-010 "submission history")

Every recorded change to the item and its variants, newest first.
Price changes are the entries where price_kobo differs

AddItemRequest.description:
One item to add to an open visit (FR-ORD-012), or for an extra-service
request (FR-ADD-001) with its optional note.
AddItemRequest.title: AddItemRequest

AllocationMethod.description:
How credit for one service is split between contributors (PRD-7.5-3). | | |---| | `equal`
Everyone gets the same share. | | `primary_assistant`
The primary gets a configured percentage; assistants share the rest equally. | | `custom`
Shares entered by a supervisor, totalling exactly 100%. |
AllocationMethod.title: AllocationMethod

AllocationRequest.description: A supervisor's change to one record's split (FR-ATTR-009).
AllocationRequest.title: AllocationRequest

AnonymiseCustomerRequest.description: Removing personal data cannot be undone, so the owner types REMOVE.
AnonymiseCustomerRequest.title: AnonymiseCustomerRequest

AssignmentsRequest.description: Who is expected to do a service. An empty list leaves it unassigned (FR-ORD-006).
AssignmentsRequest.title: AssignmentsRequest

ContributorsRequest.description: Everyone who should be on a record, edited by the person who recorded it.
ContributorsRequest.title: ContributorsRequest

CorrectExecutionRequest.description:
A corrected record: who did the work, who was the primary, optionally a
different split, and why (FR-EXE-010).
CorrectExecutionRequest.title: CorrectExecutionRequest

LoginRequest.description: Sign in with an email address or a phone number (P1 Q1).
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

OptionalReasonRequest.description: Approving or withdrawing a request, where a reason is welcome but not required.
OptionalReasonRequest.title: OptionalReasonRequest

PriceOverrideRequest.description: A new unit price for one item on a visit, with the mandatory reason (FR-ORD-011).
PriceOverrideRequest.title: PriceOverrideRequest

ReasonRequest.description:
Actions that need a written reason: cancellations, rejections, disputes
and their resolution (SRS §6).
ReasonRequest.title: ReasonRequest

SaveRoleRequest.description:
Create or edit a role. Caps are in basis points (1,000 = 10%) and kobo;
null means unlimited.
SaveRoleRequest.title: SaveRoleRequest

SplitMethod.description: The default way a service's credit is shared between the staff who do it (FR-ATTR-004, FR-ATTR-007). Custom percentages are chosen per visit with allocation.override, not in the catalogue (P2 Q2). The values match the allocation calculator's methods.
SplitMethod.title: SplitMethod

StoreItemRequest.description: A new service or product, or with parent_id a new variant of a service.
StoreItemRequest.title: StoreItemRequest

StoreOrderRequest.description:
A new visit: a registered customer or a guest with an optional name and
phone (FR-CUS-003, FR-CUS-005), and one or more items (FR-ORD-002).
StoreOrderRequest.title: StoreOrderRequest

SubmitExecutionRequest.description:
Recording a service: the colleagues who worked on it, and the primary
when the person recording does no salon work (P3 Q1).
SubmitExecutionRequest.title: SubmitExecutionRequest

TaxMode.description:
| | |---| | `exclusive`
Tax is added on top of the price. | | `inclusive`
The price already contains the tax. |
TaxMode.title: TaxMode

UpdateSettingsRequest.description:
Partial save of the business profile and settings. Send only what
changed, with the version the screen was loaded with.
UpdateSettingsRequest.title: UpdateSettingsRequest

UpdateTaxRequest.description:
The single tax (FR-TAX-001, FR-TAX-008). The rate is in basis points:
750 is 7.5%.
UpdateTaxRequest.title: UpdateTaxRequest

UploadLogoRequest.description:
PNG or JPEG, at most 1 MB. The real file content is checked, not just
the file name.
UploadLogoRequest.title: UploadLogoRequest

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
